provider: India Meteorological Department (archived via NOAA NCEI GSOD & Ogimet WMO FM-12 SYNOP)
coverage_or_product: Historical daily & 3-hourly SYNOP surface station observations for Dehradun (WMO 42111; 30.3167N, 78.0333E, 682 m)
fit_for_corridor: Best available official IMD ground gauge; directly validates valley rainfall, though located ~12-15 km SSW and ~700-1400 m lower than hill slide zones.
limitations: Mussoorie WMO 42112 returned HTTP 404 in GSOD; GSOD 2025 ends Aug/Sep and 2026 not yet published (filled via Ogimet SYNOP); localized cloudbursts (e.g., Sep 16 2025 Sahastradhara 192 mm vs Dehradun 28 mm) can differ sharply from valley gauge.
observations_downloaded: 932 valid GSOD daily obs (2023-2025) + 2544 SYNOP messages (2023-2026); 534 monsoon daily station totals exported
access_notes: Cross-checked Ogimet 03:00 UTC 24h totals against NOAA GSOD on 2023 wet peaks (124.0, 175.0, 99.0, 81.0 mm) with exact match. Ogimet HTTP 501 rate-limited Jun-Jul 2024 block (covered by GSOD 2024).

fit_for_corridor: Consistent multi-year gauge-interpolated spatial context across India.
limitations: Coarse for steep local terrain; smooths localized cloudbursts; server stability issues during download.
product_version: IMD RF25 NetCDF-3 (ind2023_rfp25.nc, ind2024_rfp25.nc, ind2025_rfp25.nc); 2026 not yet published
observations_downloaded: 0 complete grids (truncated files 5.01 MB / 3.33 MB / 0.46 MB discarded)
access_notes: POST to RF25.php returned HTTP 200 CDF\x01 NetCDF-3 headers but IMD Pune server forcibly reset TCP connections mid-stream (curl exit 56 / IncompleteRead) before 25 MB files completed; direct static HEAD requests timed out.

fit_for_corridor: Useful event timing and spatial pattern where credentials are configured.
limitations: Requires authenticated NASA Earthdata Login token; satellite estimates have orographic/mountain retrieval uncertainty.
access_notes: Directory listing accessible (HTTP 200), but OPeNDAP subset request redirected HTTP 302 to urs.earthdata.nasa.gov OAuth; NASA PPS returned HTTP 401; ClimateSERV API returned HTTP 404; NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP timed out.

coverage_or_product: Hourly land-surface reanalysis precipitation (~9 km native land grid)
limitations: Direct Copernicus CDS API requires personal API key; Open-Meteo model=era5_land returns null for precipitation (pairing ERA5 0.25 deg precipitation in era5_seamless).
observations_downloaded: 0 direct ERA5-Land precipitation (Open-Meteo returned 0/3768 non-null); see ECMWF ERA5 and ECMWF IFS 9km rows below
access_notes: Verified directly via API: Open-Meteo archive models=era5_land returned HTTP 200 with all-null precipitation values for 30.40-30.50N, 78.10E. Downloaded native ECMWF ERA5 (0.25 deg) AND ECMWF IFS (~9 km) instead.

source: ECMWF IFS (~9 km) via Open-Meteo Archive API
provider: ECMWF (served via Open-Meteo Historical Weather API v1)
coverage_or_product: Hourly operational high-resolution precipitation archive (model=ecmwf_ifs) across 3 distinct SH-01 corridor grid cells
fit_for_corridor: Primary hourly dataset downloaded in Phase 2: resolves 3 separate ~9 km grid cells across lower, mid (Galogi/Kolukhet), and upper (JP Bend/Mussoorie) SH-01 elevation zones.
limitations: Operational analysis/short-range forecast archive rather than a gauge observation; extreme convective cloudburst peaks are still smoothed relative to point gauges.
product_version: ECMWF IFS HRES archive via Open-Meteo Archive API v1 (models=ecmwf_ifs)
observations_downloaded: 45,216 hourly observations downloaded (3 grid cells x 4 monsoon seasons 2023-2026 May28-Oct31)
access_notes: 100% complete (3,768/3,768 non-null hours per season per cell). Used to generate 1h, 3h, 6h, 24h, and 72h rainfall for all 34 events and 24 non-event control dates.

source: ECMWF ERA5 Reanalysis via Open-Meteo Archive API
provider: ECMWF / Copernicus C3S (served via Open-Meteo Archive API v1)
fit_for_corridor: Consistent multi-year reanalysis benchmark across 2023-2026; exact precipitation forcing underlying ERA5-Land.
limitations: Coarse 0.25 deg cell (30.50N, 78.00E) covers the entire Dehradun-Mussoorie hill corridor in a single grid cell.
product_version: ECMWF ERA5 (Copernicus C3S; Open-Meteo Archive API v1 models=era5)
observations_downloaded: 15,072 unique hourly observations downloaded (4 monsoon seasons 2023-2026 May28-Oct31)
access_notes: 100% complete (3,768/3,768 non-null hours per season). Cross-checked alongside ECMWF IFS 9km for all 58 event/control windows.

fit_for_corridor: Independent NASA reanalysis hourly cross-check accessible without Earthdata authentication.
limitations: Very coarse (~55 km) grid smooths Himalayan orographic gradients and localized storms.
product_version: NASA POWER API v2.10.5 / MERRA-2 GMAO 5.12.4
observations_downloaded: 15,264 hourly observations downloaded (4 monsoon seasons 2023-2026 May27-Nov01)
access_notes: 100% complete (3,816/3,816 valid hours per season). Used as secondary independent hourly cross-check in historical_rainfall_event_windows.csv.

limitations: No hourly values (cannot produce 1h/3h/6h windows); mountain satellite estimates have limitations.
access_notes: Not prioritized in Phase 2 because daily resolution cannot generate required 1h, 3h, and 6h rainfall windows; hourly ECMWF IFS, ERA5, and NASA POWER were downloaded instead.
